pages.text: The first time you make the artifact whole, the three freed heroes come to it and your $(l)strike force$() gathers round it: transports — overlords, medivacs, a warp prism — full of workers and ground troops of all three races, and an air fleet of mutalisks, a corruptor, vikings, a banshee, phoenixes and a void ray. It goes up the beam into the portal, and the heroes go back to their ships.$(br2)In the Void it is your army, of your $(l)base in the Void$() (600 minerals and 300 vespene to start): build there and train more.
